title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to add or subtract hours from a DateTime field
summary: Adding or subtracting hours from DateTime fields in Business Central can be done using the AddHoursToDateTime procedure from the Type Helper codeunit. This is useful for timezone conversions and date-time manipulations in AL code.
key_points: The Type Helper codeunit provides an AddHoursToDateTime procedure for simple hour arithmetic on DateTime fields
Pass positive values to add hours and negative values to subtract hours
This method is simpler than working with Duration data type when you only need to adjust hours
Timezone conversions can be achieved by adding or subtracting hours based on the offset between UTC and the target timezone

quotes.text: if you only need to add or subtract hours from a DateTime field, there's an even simpler method
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that AddHoursToDateTime is a convenient alternative to Duration calculations for hour-only adjustments
